name: Stuttgart

queries.query: Stuttgart ALKIS WFS Flurstücke LGL Baden-Württemberg offizielle offene Geodaten
queries.result: Die Stadt Stuttgart beschreibt ihr Geoportal und die Flurstücksauskunft; der LGL Baden-Württemberg stellt einen anonym nutzbaren ALKIS-WFS bereit. Eine auf 40 × 40 m um den WUP-Punkt begrenzte Abfrage lieferte drei vollständige Stuttgarter Flurstückspolygone. Der WUP-Punkt liegt in keinem dieser drei Polygone.

queries.query: Stuttgart official open ALKIS cadastral parcel WFS feature geometry safe field schema
queries.result: Official ALKIS WFS returned three complete Polygon features identified as Stuttgart. The exact WUP point is not covered by those three; citywide coverage and completeness were not tested.

source.name: Baden-Württemberg LGL ALKIS cadastral parcels
source.operator: Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Baden-Württemberg (LGL)
source.scope: 78 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 78 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Stuttgart parcels returned through the Baden-Württemberg LGL ALKIS service; nearby valid ground is verified, without requiring the settlement centroid itself to fall inside a parcel. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
source.identityBasis: Fresh bounded adapter qualification uses the publisher native cadastral key, preserving complete geometry and separate transport IDs.
